rationale: Across three seeds C1 U-Net has nearly identical AbsRel, slightly lower boundary F1 and more parameters than the internal-feature CNN. No-RGB single-seed control fails the predeclared non-decreasing F1 promotion criterion. Retain both as measured controls, do not expand combinations.
resolution_scope: One-seed sensitivity comparison of spatial input resolution, holding epoch protocol and architecture fixed. Primary confirmed method remains 240x320 unless resolution delivers clear improvements and is independently confirmed; no final test selection.
resolution_promotion_rule: For the selected internal-feature method only: if 480 achieves at least 1% relative lower validation AbsRel AND at least +0.002 absolute boundary F1 over matching 240 seed320112, confirm480 with the other two declared seeds before considering it as final resolution. Otherwise retain one-seed diagnostic and240 primary. No extra architecture/loss search.
